purpose: Create the business-neutral effective-dated workforce, organization, position, assignment, subject-association, and idempotency receipt structures.
lockImpact: Creates a new module-owned schema, tables, indexes, functions, and triggers only; no existing application table is rewritten or locked. At runtime, placement writes take one transaction-scoped organization hierarchy advisory lock so concurrent hierarchy changes are serialized.
dataImpact: Creates empty organization structures. No people, company units, positions, assignments, authentication subjects, or business data are inserted.
backfill: Not required. The first release starts with empty structures and only accepts explicit controlled commands.
recovery: Roll back the application while leaving the additive empty or populated schema intact. Restore the pre-migration recovery point only before any organization facts are accepted; never drop populated history mechanically.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed organization-owned migration for constraint or schema repairs. Do not rewrite this migration after it has been applied.
